tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind panels and lists.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, dialogs, side sheets (chat, participants).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips: anything floating above surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, wells, segmented-control tracks, code blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and quiet borders between areas. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control (input, toggle track, secondary button). At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (meta, timestamps, helper text) on every surface. 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled-adjacent hints on every surface. Still 4.5:1. Never for essential content.

tokens.name: accent-sky
tokens.usage: Sky blue accent fill: primary buttons, active controls, selected states. Text on it is on-accent-sky.

tokens.name: on-accent-sky
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent-sky fill (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: accent-sky-text
tokens.usage: Sky blue accent as text, links and focus rings on every surface and on accent-sky-soft.

tokens.name: accent-sky-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet sky blue tint: selected rows, accent badges, own chat bubbles. Text on it is accent-sky-text or ink.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The user's chosen accent fill. Defaults to sky; the app re-points accent* to another accent-<name> set when the user picks a color.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text and links on any surface.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet accent tint (selected row, own chat message).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset. Follows the chosen accent. 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text/icons (connected, saved) on any surface; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background for success badges and banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution text/icons (weak connection, waiting room) on any surface; paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background for warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive text/icons on any surface; paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background for error banners and the muted-mic badge.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of destructive buttons (Leave, End for all, Remove).

tokens.name: on-danger-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on danger-fill.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Meeting room background behind video tiles. Dark in both themes so video reads well.

tokens.name: stage-tile
tokens.usage: Video tile when the camera is off; holds the avatar.

tokens.name: stage-ink
tokens.usage: Names, labels and icons on stage and stage-tile.

tokens.name: stage-scrim
tokens.usage: Name-label and caption backdrop over live video.

tokens.name: stage-danger
tokens.usage: Muted-mic icon on stage labels (on stage-scrim).

tokens.name: stage-warning
tokens.usage: Weak-connection text and icon on stage-scrim.

tokens.name: hand-raised
tokens.usage: Raised-hand pill on video tiles and the participant list highlight.

tokens.name: on-hand-raised
tokens.usage: Text and icon on hand-raised.

tokens.name: speaking
tokens.usage: Ring around the active speaker's tile and avatar (3px). Paired with the audio-level icon, never color alone.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home greeting and empty-state headlines. One per screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section and panel headings (Chat, Participants, Minutes sections).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ali will ship the invite flow by Thursday.
styles.usage: Default text: chat, minutes, transcripts, AI answers.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text; speaker names in transcripts.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, form labels, tabs, name labels on video tiles.

styles.name: live-caption
styles.sample: I think we can ship it on Thursday.
styles.usage: Live captions over the meeting stage (stage-ink on stage-scrim).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Meeting codes, transcript timestamps (00:14:32), technical IDs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls; between related items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and list-row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between control-bar groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkbox, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, chat bubbles, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, video tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the floating meeting control bar.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, avatars, round control buttons, toggles, badges-as-pills.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Raised cards on bg.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips, the floating control bar.
